mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with temperatures at 63 degrees under a first quarter moon.

The city has announced that chip sealing road treatments will begin September 23, affecting Cross Country Road, parts of East Verona Avenue, and the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission will meet on October 5 to discuss various development projects.

We have a busy weekend ahead, starting with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard occurring today. Plus, look forward to Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
On September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I, second offence, after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM with today's flavor of the day, so make sure to stop by and satisfy your craving.
